description: Unaligned nucleotide sequences to a tree. Three tools, three port types, two wires. fasttree.infer declares requires.alphabet = nucleotide, so protein input is refused pre-flight rather than producing a plausible tree under the wrong model. See BLU-22.

$regression.$comment: BLU-22. These must keep behaving this way; the protein case is the one that silently produced a wrong tree, and the ambiguous case is the door it would come back through.

must_be_refused.tools/corpus/alphabet/04-ambiguous-short: alphabet undetermined; uncertainty must block rather than be resolved optimistically
